question: What analogy illustrates how one should protect the one born in this context?
premises: A mother may bear a child from a lover.
She still protects that child as her own son.
This protection serves as a model for the prescribed conduct.
inference: One should protect him just as a mother protects her own son even if born from a lover.
uncertainties: The ritual or symbolic referent of the protected one depends on context.
plain_english: Just as a mother protects her own son even if he was born from a lover, so should one protect him.
